description: Default capability for the GameLib shell: core defaults plus the opener plugin (the shell.openExternal / steam:// parity path). Tauri v2 capabilities gate WEBVIEW->Rust IPC only; they are not consulted for Rust-side plugin API calls. The four app-defined relay commands (sidecar_invoke, sidecar_send, open_external, sidecar_store_snapshot) are registered via invoke_handler and do not require capability permissions. For the same reason the native file/folder picker (dialog.showOpenDialog parity, plan 30-03) needs NO dialog permission here: dispatch_rust_channel calls app.dialog().file() from Rust. Granting 'dialog:allow-open' would have exposed plugin:dialog|open directly to renderer JavaScript (including anything running in the store WebView surface) for zero benefit to the intended path — WR-03. notification:allow-is-permission-granted is the ONLY notification permission granted, and it is required, not optional: tauri-plugin-notification (added plan 33-04) auto-injects init-iife.js into every webview, which on non-Windows unconditionally invokes plugin:notification|is_permission_granted at load — without the grant that invoke is denied and crashes startup with an unhandled rejection. The full notification:default set is deliberately NOT granted (WR-03): real OS notifications go Rust-side via the notification_show relay (Rust plugin API calls bypass capabilities), and the frontend never uses window.Notification, so plugin:notification|notify / show / request_permission stay unexposed to the renderer.
